entries.en_definition: Molecules or ions that can donate protons (H+) in aqueous solution to produce hydronium ions (H₃O+) and pH < 7
entries.to_definition: Ko e molekula pe 'ioni 'oku ne lava 'o foaki e polotoni (H+)'i he solusoni vai ke fakatupu ha 'ioni haitoluniumi (H₃O+), pH <7.

entries.en_definition: Base like sodium hydroxide (NaOH) dissolves in water to produce alkaline solutions by directly liberating hydroxide ions (OH-) and pH > 7
entries.to_definition: Ko e peisi hange ko e NaOH 'oku lava 'o fakamovete he vai mo tukuange hangatonu e 'ioni haitokisaiti (OH-) 'i he vai, pH >7.

entries.en_definition: The smallest building block of any element. It is made up of protons & neutrons inside the nucleus with electrons surrounding the nucleus
entries.to_definition: Ko e konga si'isi'i taha 'o e elemeniti pea 'oku fa'u'aki e polotoni mo e niutoloni 'i he uho'i 'atomi pea takatakai 'e he 'ilekituloni.

entries.en_definition: A characteristic number that determines the identity of an element & the number of protons & electrons in its atom (e.g. ₂₀Ca for Calcium)
entries.to_definition: Ko e mata'ifika 'oku ne tala e makehe 'a e elemeniti mo e lahi 'o e polotoni mo e 'ilekituloni he 'atomi takitaha (e.g. ₂₀Ca)

entries.en_definition: Molecules or ions than can accept protons (H+) from water to produce hydroxide ions (OH-) and pH > 7
entries.to_definition: Ko e molekula pe 'ioni 'oku lava 'o tali e polotoni mei he vai ke ma'u ai e 'ioni haitokisaiti pH >7.

entries.en_definition: Solutions or systems whose pH remains relatively constant when small amounts of acid or base are added (e.g. blood buffer)
entries.to_definition: Solusoni 'oku ta'eliliu e pH neongo hono tānaki atu e 'esiti pē peisi si'isi'i pe.

entries.en_definition: An ion that has a positive charge (e.g. Na+)
entries.to_definition: Ko e 'ioni positivi hangē ko e sotiumi Na+.

entries.en_definition: The electrode (i.e. inert solid like Platinum, Pt) where reduction occurs in an electrochemical cell.
entries.to_definition: Ko e kefote hange ko e palatiumi (Pt) 'oku hoko ai e 'okisikena molia 'i ha sela kemikale'uhila.

entries.en_definition: The use of symbols & numbers as subscripts to show the amounts & type of atoms found in a single compound (e.g. rust is Fe₂O₃)
entries.to_definition: Ko e ngāue'aki e ngaahi faka'ilonga mo e mata'ifika ke ne tala e lahi 'o e 'atomi 'i ha fo'i komipauni hangē ko e 'ume'umea Fe₂O₃.

entries.en_definition: When different chemicals/reactants combine to form new chemicals/products with different compositions (e.g. CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O)
entries.to_definition: Ko e ngaahi liliu fakakemikale kehekehe 'oku nau fanau'i mai e ngaahi komipauni fo'ou hangē ko e CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O.

entries.en_definition: Burning of any substance with oxygen gas which produce carbon dioxide or carbon monoxide, water, heat or light.
entries.to_definition: Ko e vela fakakemi mo e 'okisikena ke fakatupu vai, mafana, mo e kaponi tai'okisaiti.

entries.en_definition: Substance that contains 2 or more elements that are chemically bonded together in a fixed ratio (e.g. glucose is C₆H₁₂O₆)
entries.to_definition: Ko e kemikale fa'u'aki e 'elemeniti 'e 2 pe lahi ange hangē ko e suka lōtaha C₆H₁₂O₆.

entries.en_definition: A measure of of the amount of solute in a fixed amount of solvent. Concentration = c = n/V where n =number of moles of solute, V= Volume (L)
entries.to_definition: Ko e fua e lahi 'o e soliuti 'i ha soloveni fakatatau ki he 'ekuasi c = n/V ko e n = lahi e soliuti fua he mole, V= Voliume (L).

entries.en_definition: A change in the state of matter from gas to liquid (e.g. water vapour in the air changes to liquid water/morning dew)
entries.to_definition: Ko e liliu fakakemi 'a e mao ki he vai.

entries.en_definition: Any material that allows an electric current or electricity to pass through it (e.g. metals like iron, copper etc.)
entries.to_definition: Ko e matelie 'oku ne lava e fakafononga e 'uhila hangē ko e 'aione mo e kopa.

entries.en_definition: The flow of electrical energy due to the movement of electrons through a conductor/wire
entries.to_definition: Ko e ivi'i 'uhila 'oku fakafononga 'e he 'ilekituloni he uaea 'uhila.

entries.en_definition: An aqueous ionic salt solution or molten ionic liquid that conducts electricity (i.e. ions are free to move & conduct electricity)
entries.to_definition: Ko e 'ioni vai pē solusoni masima 'oku taka ke fakafononga e ivi'i 'uhila.

entries.en_definition: Sub-atomic particles: Each electron has a charge of negative one (-1), a mass close to zero & do not contribute much to the atomic mass
entries.to_definition: Ko e tekonga 'atomi 'ilekituloni 'oku nekativi taha (-1) pea ko e ki'i konga si'i pē ia 'o e mamafa e 'atomi.

entries.en_definition: A pure substance containing only one type of atom with the same atomic number & mass number (e.g. Carbon, ¹²₆C)
entries.to_definition: Ko e 'elemeniti 'oku haohaoa he ko e fa'ahinga 'atomi pē 'e taha 'oku fika 'atomi tatau pe mo hono mamafa hangē koe Kaponi, ¹²₆C.

entries.en_definition: A reaction where energy/heat is absorbed from the surrounding (i.e. Energy of the products > Energy of the reactants)
entries.to_definition: Ko e liliu fakakemi 'oku ne mimisi mai e ivi mei he 'ātakai.

entries.en_definition: A written represenation of a chemical reaction using symbols, chemical formula & numbers to balance (e.g. 2Na + 2H₂O → 2NaOH + H₂ )
entries.to_definition: Ko e founga tohi 'o e 'ekuasi fakakemikale 'o ngāue'aki e ngaahi mata'itohi mo e mata'ifika ke fakapalanisi.

entries.en_definition: A reversible reaction where the forward & backward reactions occur at the same rate & the concentrations of reactants & products are constant
entries.to_definition: Ko e palanisi 'a e liliu fakakemi ki he hoko atu mo e fakafoki mai 'i he taimi tatau pē pea tu'uma'u 'ikai to e liliu 'a hono taufua.

entries.en_definition: A change in the state of matter from a liquid into a gas (e.g.steam from boiling water)
entries.to_definition: Ko e liliu fakakemi 'a e vai ki he mao.

entries.en_definition: A reaction where energy/heat is released to the surrounding (i.e. Energy of the products < Energy of the reactants),
entries.to_definition: Ko e liliu fakakemi 'oku ne tukuange mai e ivi ki he 'ātakai.

entries.en_definition: Particles are moving rapidly in all directions, high energy & they occupy all the available space.
entries.to_definition: Ko e tekonga kasa 'oku 'alu fano ke fakafonu e 'atā kotoa pē.

entries.en_definition: Ions are charged particles formed when atoms lose or gain electrons in order to form a stable full outer shell of electrons.
entries.to_definition: Ko 'ioni ko e tekonga 'atomi kuo tānaki pe kole mai hono 'ilekituloni ke fakafonu takai 'a tu'a.

entries.en_definition: These are different forms of the same element with the same atomic number but different mass number (e.g. ¹²₆C and ¹⁴₆C).
entries.to_definition: Ko e fa'ahinga kehekehe 'o e 'elemeniti tatau mo hono fika 'atomi tatau kae kehe 'aupito hono fika mamafa.

entries.en_definition: A pH indicator used to determine whether a solution is an acid or base. Acids turn blue litmus paper red. Bases turn red litmus paper blue.
entries.to_definition: Pepa 'oku ne fakahaa'i e pH pe ko e 'esiti pē peisi. Ko e 'esiti 'oku ne liliu e pulū ke kulokula. Ko e peisi 'oku ne liliu e kulokula ke pulū.

entries.en_definition: Particles move around each other slowly, definite volume, no fixed shape/takes the volume of the container.
entries.to_definition: Ko e tekonga vai 'oku fe'unuaki māmālie pē 'i he voliume tatau ka e toki mahino pē hono fōtunga fakatatau ki he fōtunga 'o e me'a 'ai'anga vai.

entries.en_definition: There are 3 states of matter: solids, liquid and gas.
entries.to_definition: Ko e ngaahi tūkunga 'o e matelie: soliti, vai mo e kasa.

entries.en_definition: The temperature where a substance changes phase from a solid to a liquid at normal atmospheric pressure.
entries.to_definition: Ko e fua mafana 'oku lava liliu ai e soliti 'o vai.

entries.en_definition: Solids with an array of positive metal ions in a "sea" of delocalised electrons (i.e. metallic bond); good conductors, ductible, malleable, high m.p.
entries.to_definition: Ko e soliti 'oku laine ai e metali 'ioni positivi mo hono ngaahi hoko fakametali 'o hoko ko e matelie fakafononga 'uhila lelei.

entries.en_definition: This is how many moles of solute in one liter of the solution (number of moles = n = m/M where m = mass, M= Molar mass)
entries.to_definition: Ko e lahi 'o e tu'oni 'atomi solute he lita 'e taha 'o e solusoni 'o fakatatau ki he 'ekuasi n=m/M.

entries.en_definition: A unit of measurement used by chemist to measure the number of particles (atoms, ions etc.). 1 mole = 6.023 x 10²³ particles (i.e. Avogadro's Number)
entries.to_definition: Ko e tu'oni 'atomi 'oku fika'i 'aki e lahi 'o e 'atomi pē 'ioni. Mole 'atomi 'e 1 = 'atomi ia 'e 6.023 x 10²³ (Fika Avokato)

entries.en_definition: When 2 or more atoms share their electrons & form covalent bonds, they form small new chemical structure (e.g. H₂, NH₃, CO₂)
entries.to_definition: Ko e taimi 'oku vahevahe ai 'e he 'atomi 'e 2 pe lahi ange 'a e 'ilekituloni mo e hoko fakakemi ke fa'u'aki ha kemikale fo'ou.

entries.en_definition: Use of symbols & numbers in subscript to show the amounts & type of atoms found in a single molecule (e.g. water H₂O)
entries.to_definition: Ko e ngāue'aki e ngaahi faka'ilonga mo e mata'ifika 'o e 'atomi 'i ha fo'i molekula 'e taha hangē ko e vai H₂O.

entries.en_definition: When the hydronium ion (H₃O+) concentration is the same as the hydroxide (OH-) concentration in aqueous solutions (i.e. pH = 7)
entries.to_definition: Ko e taimi 'oku lahi tatau ai e peisi mo e 'esiti 'i ha solusoni pea pH=7.

entries.en_definition: Sub-atomic particles: Each neutron has a charge of zero (0), has similar mass to a proton & contributes significantly to the atomic mass
entries.to_definition: Ko e tekonga 'atomi niutoloni kotoa pē 'oku noa, pea mamafa tatau mo e polotoni, 'o kaungatonu ki he mamafa faka'atomi.

entries.en_definition: This is the center of the atom & contains protons and neutrons. The number of protons & neutrons are used to calculate the atomic mass
entries.to_definition: Ko e uho eni 'o e 'atomi 'oku 'i ai e polotoni mo e niutoloni. Ko e lahi 'o e polotoni mo e niutoloni 'oku fika'i 'aki e mamafa faka'atomi.

entries.en_definition: It is gain of oxygen, loss of hydrogen, loss of electrons & increase in oxidation number or charge of an ion.
entries.to_definition: Oku tānaki mai e 'okisikena, kae mole atu e 'ilekituloni pea fakalahi e fika 'okisaiti pe 'ioni.

entries.en_definition: An ordered arrangement of ~118 elements into groups & periods according to their atomic numbers, electronic configuration & properties
entries.to_definition: Ko e tēpile 'oku tu'u fakahokohoko ai e ngaahi 'elemeniti 'e 118 'o fakakulupu fakatatau ki he fika faka'atomi mo e naunau 'ilekituloni.

entries.en_definition: A measure of the [H₃O+ ] concentration in aqueous solutions: pH = -log₁₀[H₃O+ ]. The pH scale is from 1to 14. Acids:pH<7, Base: pH>7
entries.to_definition: Ko e me'afua 'esiti mo e peisi. pH mei he 1-14. Ko e 'esiti 'oku pH < 7 pea peisi 'oku pH > 7 pea lava ke fika'e pH = -log₁₀[H₃O+ ].

entries.en_definition: An insoluble solid (s) formed when two different solutions are mixed (e.g. PbI₂ (s) is formed from mixing lead nitrate & KI solutions).
entries.to_definition: Ko e soliti mei he fefiohi fakakemi 'a e solusoni 'e 2.

entries.en_definition: Each proton has a charge of positive one (+1), has similar mass to a neutron & contributes significantly to the atomic mass
entries.to_definition: Ko e tekonga 'atomi polotoni 'oku positivi 'e taha (+1) pea mamafa tatau mo e niutoloni 'e taha pea kaungatonu ki he mamafa 'o e 'atomi.

entries.en_definition: It is the loss of oxygen, gain of Hydrogen, gain of electrons & decrease in oxidation number or charge of an ion.
entries.to_definition: Ko e mole atu 'a e 'okisikena, kae tānaki mai 'a e haitokena, 'ilekituloni, mo e holo 'a e fika 'okisaiti pē 'ioni.

entries.en_definition: Particles vibrate around a fixed position, fixed shape, fixed volume & rigid/cannot be compressed easily.
entries.to_definition: Ko e tekonga soliti 'oku ngaungaue he potu, fōtunga mo e voliume tu'uma'u pea 'ikai ke malomi ngofua.

entries.en_definition: This is the solid component of a solution (e.g. aqueous sugar solution, sugar is the solute)
entries.to_definition: Ko e konga soliti 'o ha solusoni.

entries.en_definition: A solution is formed by dissolving a solute in a solvent (e.g. salt solution is formed by dissolving salt/solute in the water/solvent).
entries.to_definition: Ko e solusoni 'oku fa'u 'e he solute tānaki ki he soloveni.

entries.en_definition: This is the liquid component of a solution (e.g. aqueous sugar solution, water is the solvent)
entries.to_definition: Ko e tekonga vai 'o ha solusoni.

entries.en_definition: Any small piece of matter like protons, neutrons and electrons that make up atoms.
entries.to_definition: Ko e kongokonga 'atomi hangē ko e polotoni, niutoloni mo e 'ilekituloni.

entries.en_definition: A change in the state of matter from solid to gas without changing to a liquid first (e.g. Iodine)
entries.to_definition: Ko e liliu fakakemi 'a e soliti ki he kasa.

entries.en_definition: A analytical technique in the lab that uses a standard solution (usually a base) to determine the unknown concentration of an acid
entries.to_definition: Ko e founga fakakemi 'o e fehu'i'aki 'o e peisi mo e 'esiti ke 'ilo e taufua 'o e 'esiti.
